items.en: BFGoodrich has become a new Premium Partner of FC Schalke 04, the German sports club best known for its Bundesliga football team. The agreement initially runs until 2028. Neither Schalke 04 nor BFGoodrich have shared specific details about the partnership within the club’s second-highest sponsorship tier.
Halfords’ 100th Fusion format garage in in Ashington, Northumberland (Photo: Halfords)

Halfords Group plc has released an interim update after “strong trading” in the 26 weeks ending 2 October 2026. Group like-for-like (LfL) sales grew 7.1 per cent, supporting the FY27 profit upgrade communicated in the trading update on 27 August 2026.
